newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent Nov/Dec intermonth spread widens in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Brent Nov/Dec intermonth spread widens in Asia.

text.p: The Brent spread for November/December widened during Asia hours on Wednesday, supported by bidding from a European major, brokers said.
The major paid 55 cents for Nov/Dec spread from a Wall Street trade house pushing quotes mid-afternoon on Wednesday to 53/57 cents.
On Tuesday, the spread was assessed at 42/44 in London and 44/47 later in New York.
The major said it was also bidding four to five cents over the screen for December partial Brent cargoes.
A December/January Dubai spread was traded by a major to a trader late on Tuesday at 49 cents in line with a deal on Monday.
Tapis values were up around five cents per barrel on the day.
December was bid at $24.70 compared with a day-earlier $24.65.
